newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close lower, await U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close lower, await U.S. jobs data.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Dutch bonds closed with big losses. Prices drifted off after the Bundesbank left its rates unchanged, though this was expected, and later extended their losses as U.S. treasuries turned weaker amid some nervousness ahead of tomorrow's U.S. November employment data. * Sept 2001 116.80/90, bid yld 4.72 pct vs 117.18/28, 4.64 * Jan 2006 101.89/97, bid yield 5.72 pct vs 102.64/72, 5.62 * 10-yr yld spread vs April 2006 bund widens to -5 basis points
